status: V10.0 reconstructed baseline built; not flashed
reconstruction_changes: Target update and motion restart separated: 1-2us updates target, >=3us restarts phase; initial command starts phase.
Removed dead cmd_sensitive countdown and ADC-delta command triggers, per original control disassembly.
Motion restart does not reset hold_deviation_count, matching original instruction sequence.
Preserved ADC/PWM/H-bridge files and V9.6 HOLD behavior; did not apply L1/L2 tuning.
Restored original full runtime UI rather than L1 diagnostic-only UI.
limitations: Reconstructed C is not proven to be the original source text or a byte-exact original application.
394 concrete single-step cases are sampled software equivalence, not exhaustive formal proof or a dynamic motor model.
ADC/PWM inputs were modeled; hardware interrupts, noise, current, and real UART timings were not tested.
UI check intercepts display output, models snprintf equally and skips waits; it does not test real touch/UART timing.
angr CFG matching and pseudocode have heuristic boundaries, especially Cortex-M0 long-branch thunks.
Original board V9.6 remains installed; V10.0 hardware stability unverified.
